description: This file defines a PHP class SugarWidgetSubPanelManageAcceptancesButton that extends SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButton. It provides a method to generate HTML for a button that manages acceptances, intended for use within a SugarCRM subpanel.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelManageAcceptancesButton
classes.description: A widget class for rendering a 'Manage Acceptances' button in SugarCRM subpanels, extending the generic top button class.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates and returns HTML code for a 'Manage Acceptances' button within a form, which triggers a JavaScript function when clicked.
